description: This file defines the 'MenuItem' entity class for the OrangeHRM system, using Doctrine ORM annotations to map properties to database columns and relationships. It includes properties such as id, menuTitle, parent, level, orderHint, status, screen, and additionalParams, along with getter and setter methods for each.

classes.name: MenuItem
classes.description: Entity class representing a menu item within the OrangeHRM system, including hierarchical relationships, display order, status, associated screen, and additional parameters.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the menu item.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the menu item.

methods.name: getMenuTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the menu item.

methods.name: setMenuTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the menu item.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent MenuItem, if any.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Returns the hierarchical level of the menu item.

methods.name: setLevel
methods.description: Sets the hierarchical level of the menu item.

methods.name: getOrderHint
methods.description: Returns the order hint used for sorting menu items.

methods.name: setOrderHint
methods.description: Sets the order hint for sorting menu items.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns whether the menu item is active or not.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the active status of the menu item.

methods.name: getAdditionalParams
methods.description: Returns additional parameters as an array.

methods.name: setAdditionalParams
methods.description: Sets additional parameters for the menu item.
